title: Isolate disposable enable-timing samples from pending work in a failed sample's Tokio runtime
outcome: A failed timing sample's async or blocking work cannot silently overlap a later size's measurement window.
acceptance: Each disposable enable-timing sample either owns a separately drained runtime that is retired before the next sample, or explicitly marks later measurements as potentially contaminated after failure.
Review and focused failure-path evidence cover the chosen isolation or disclosure behavior without retrying failed samples, changing product deadlines, or touching live data.
